title: Chained workflow events need a GitHub App token; GITHUB_TOKEN-created events do not start other workflows
answers: Copilot PR stays draft after review request, Copilot review never starts
gh pr ready with GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger the next workflow
how to chain a workflow that publishes a PR to another workflow listening for ready_for_review
why does my workflow's PR edit not start the pull_request_target workflow
body:
Symptom: A Copilot coding-agent PR stays a draft after the agent requests review, and the Copilot review request never runs.
Root cause: Events created with secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger other workflow runs. A `gh pr ready` that uses GITHUB_TOKEN therefore cannot start copilot-review.yml on `ready_for_review`. See .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft.
Fix pattern: Run the publish in its own workflow. Create a token with actions/create-github-app-token (APP_CLIENT_ID / APP_PRIVATE_KEY), pass it as GH_TOKEN to `gh pr ready`, and let the downstream workflow listen for `ready_for_review`. Alternative when no downstream event is needed: keep the publish step and the review request in one job, so `gh pr ready` and `gh pr edit --add-reviewer @copilot` run in the same invocation (.github/workflows/copilot-review.yml:request-review).
Constraints: Needed only when the emitted event must start another workflow. The app token needs both permission-contents: write and permission-pull-requests: write, because the in-code comment says markPullRequestReadyForReview rejects pull-requests: write alone (cli/cli#8910). Prefer the app token over widening GITHUB_TOKEN. The same-job alternative fails if the consumer must be a separate workflow that listens for `ready_for_review`.
applies: Any step in .github/workflows that must emit an event consumed by another workflow in this repo.

search: Workflow events generated with secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger downstream workflows, requiring a GitHub App token to chain events across workflows. In .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml:publish-draft, executing gh pr ready with GITHUB_TOKEN prevents .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml from triggering on ready_for_review. To chain workflows, generate a token via actions/create-github-app-token with APP_CLIENT_ID and APP_PRIVATE_KEY, passing it as GH_TOKEN to gh pr ready. The token requires permission-contents: write and permission-pull-requests: write, though combining pr ready and reviewer assignment into one job is an alternative when downstream events are unneeded.
